metadata.title: Gusto - orders with your suppliers
metadata.description: A B2B ordering platform for restaurants, cafés, hotels and their suppliers.

hero.title: Orders without the calls and chats.
hero.body: Suppliers manage their catalogs, individual prices and orders. Their customers order easily and keep track of deliveries.

facts.feeBody: You settle up the way you always have

tour.title: From scattered chats to one place, in four steps.
tour.v1Cap: Upload your catalog from Excel and set each customer's own prices.
tour.v2Cap: The buyer opens the link, signs in and sees their prices.
tour.v3Title: An order in a few taps.
tour.v3Cap: The buyer picks quantities and sends the order.
tour.v4Cap: Confirm, change quantities or reject. Try it right here.
tour.inviteText: Hello! I'm inviting you to Gusto, where you'll find my catalog with your prices.
tour.inviteCard: Food Distribution invites you to Gusto

suppliers.title: Your customers, your prices.
suppliers.body: Invite the businesses you already serve. Each one gets its own price list.
suppliers.c1Body: Send the link on WhatsApp or by email.
suppliers.c3Body: Order value and your most requested products.

buyers.title: The weekly order, in one tap.
buyers.body: Restaurants, cafés, hotels and shops send their orders to the suppliers they already work with.
buyers.c1Body: The catalog shows only the prices set for you.
buyers.c2Body: Repeat a previous order in one tap.

trust.title: A closed network. Verified businesses.
trust.body: Gusto is not an open online marketplace. We check every business, and a buyer sees only their own suppliers and their own prices.
trust.i1Body: Only approved email addresses can sign in.
trust.i2Body: A buyer sees only their own prices and their own suppliers.
trust.i3Body: Every business is checked against its legal ID.
trust.i4Body: An order is a purchase request. You settle up the way you always have.

close.title: Ready to start?
close.body: Gusto is free for suppliers and for their customers. Start by sending a request.
close.sBody: Send us your business details and we'll get in touch.
close.bBody: Ask your supplier for an invitation, or contact us yourself.

demo.banner: Demo version: all data is made up and reloaded every night.
demo.accountsBody: Try Gusto with made-up data. Sign in with an email and password.

welcomeEmail.subject: Gusto - your account is ready
welcomeEmail.body:
Hello,

Your business has been approved on Gusto. To sign in and set your password, open this link:

{link}

The link is single-use and valid for a limited time. If it has expired, open the sign-in page and choose "Set or reset password" to get a new one.

If you weren't expecting this email, just ignore it.

login.title: Sign in to Gusto
login.subtitle: Only verified businesses can sign in to Gusto. First time here? Use the link from your email, or choose "Set or reset password".
login.notAllowedContact: To get approved, write to us:
login.sentBody: A sign-in link has been sent to {email}. Open the email and follow the link.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.auth: Sign-in failed. The link may have expired - try again.
errors.not_allowed: This email has not been approved yet. Only verified businesses can sign in to Gusto.
errors.wrong_credentials: The email or password is wrong.

login.supplierPrompt: Are you a supplier and want to join Gusto?
login.legalNote: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Gusto
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us briefly about your business. A verified business is activated at once; otherwise, after our approval.
onboarding.kindBuyerHint: A restaurant, café, hotel or shop
onboarding.legalIdHint: 9 digits (company) or 11 digits (sole trader). We check the ID in the registry.
onboarding.deliveryInstructionsHint: E.g.: entrance from the courtyard, receiving until 10:00.
onboarding.deliveryAreaHint: E.g.: Tbilisi and the surrounding area

errors.wrong_role: This email is registered for a different role. Please contact us.
errors.legal_id_taken: This legal ID is already registered. If it's your company, please contact us.

onboarding.kindBothHint: I buy and I sell: for example, I supply shops and restaurants

validation.invalid_legal_id: The ID must have 9 or 11 digits
validation.invalid_barcode: A barcode must have 8 to 14 digits
validation.contact_required: Enter a phone or an email so you can send the link

supplier.pendingBody: The Gusto team is checking your business. Once approved, you can invite customers and receive orders.
supplier.emptyBody: When customers send you an order, it will appear here.
supplier.noCategoriesBody: You can add products once the Gusto team adds categories.

dashboard.repeatHint: Buyers who sent you 2 or more orders in the last 30 days.

dashboard.orderedTimes: Ordered {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}

categories.intro: Categories are shared by all suppliers. An archived category can't be chosen for new products; existing ones stay unchanged.
categories.empty: No categories yet. Suppliers can't add products until at least one exists.
categories.standardHint: Adds the main HoReCa categories you don't have yet (wine, beer, cheese, meat, vegetables, sauces, packaging and so on). Existing ones are untouched. The import also recognizes these categories under other common names (for example in English).

fromFile.title: Add categories from a product file
fromFile.hint: Upload a supplier's product file (CSV or Excel) and you'll see which categories Gusto is missing. The file is read in your browser; only the category names are sent to the server.

fileErrors.too_large: The file is too large (60 MB at most).

errors.name_taken: A category with this name already exists.

pilot.title: Pilot metrics
pilot.intro: Every number is computed from real data. A "week" is a rolling 7 days.
pilot.activeSuppliersHint: Received at least 1 order in the last 30 days.
pilot.activeBuyersHint: Sent at least 1 order in the last 14 days.
pilot.reorderHint: Buyers who ordered in both of the last two weeks, divided by buyers who ordered in the earlier week. Pilot goal: buyers come back once a week without a reminder.
pilot.reorderNone: No orders in the earlier week.
pilot.perSupplierHint: Orders in the last 28 days ÷ 4 ÷ number of approved suppliers.

orders.title: Order lookup
orders.intro: Enter an order number. Every time you open one, it is recorded in the audit log.
orders.label: Order number
orders.invalid: The number is invalid. Example: GST-1001.

access.title: Access
access.intro: Only the emails added here can sign in to Gusto. Add the email of a business you have checked yourself (ID, phone): the person gets a link by email and creates their own password. A supplier's invitation doesn't open the door - an invited buyer must be on this list too.

errors.cannot_revoke_self: You can't revoke access for your own email.
errors.unknown: Could not be completed. Try again.
errors.invalid_legal_id: The ID must have 9 or 11 digits, and give the business name too.

welcome.sent: Email added. The first sign-in link has been sent.
welcome.skipped: Email added, but no message was sent: the email service isn't switched on yet.
welcome.failed: Email added, but the message could not be sent. A new link is available from the sign-in page via "Set or reset password".

bulk.title: Add many at once
bulk.welcomeNote: No message was sent to {count, plural, one {# address} other {# addresses}}. They can get the link from the sign-in page via "Set or reset password".
bulk.hint: One business per line: email, business name, ID, role (buyer or supplier). Only the email is required; give the name and ID together. At most 100 lines.
bulk.tooMany: The first 100 lines were processed; the rest were skipped.

parse.role: The role must be buyer or supplier
parse.name_or_id: The name and ID must be given together

access.roleHint: If you set a role, the person sees only that option when registering. "Both" creates a buyer side and a supplier side at once: for a business that buys and also sells.
access.verifiedHint: A name and ID mean you checked the business yourself: its account is active at once after registration. Without them, it waits for your approval.

link.ready: The sign-in link for {email} is ready.
link.warning: The link is single-use, and whoever opens it first gets in. Send it only to this person. We don't store the link anywhere, but creating it is visible in the log.
link.noPhone: The phone is unknown: WhatsApp will open and you choose the recipient yourself.

link.message: Hello! Your business has been approved on Gusto. To sign in and set your password, open this link (single-use): {link}

verification.title: Verification
verification.freeMail: This is a personal email (e.g. gmail.com), not a company one. Verify by phone.
verification.howTo: Check the ID in the registry (NAPR / RS.ge), call the number given, and approve only after that.

requests.title: Requests to join
requests.intro: Suppliers who arrive through the public form. A request gives no access: check the ID in the registry, call them, and only then approve. On approval the email is added to the access list and the supplier is active.
requests.freeMail: This is a personal email (e.g. gmail.com), not a company one. Verify by phone.

form.qtyStepHint: E.g.: 1 - whole units, 0.5 - half a kilogram

form.deactivateHint: A disabled product is hidden from buyers. Past orders stay unchanged.

import.title: Import products
import.intro: Upload your price list as CSV or Excel (.xlsx). Existing products are updated by code (SKU); new ones are added.
import.validCategoriesHint: A category in the file must match one of these. Letter case, extra spaces and common synonyms don't get in the way. To add a new category, contact Gusto support.

fileErrors.too_large: The file is too large (60 MB at most). Reduce the size of the photos and try again.
fileErrors.empty: No data was found in the file.

import.rowsFound: {count, plural, one {# row found} other {# rows found}}
import.mappingIntro: Say which column is which. * - required.
import.defaultsNote: If missing from the file: VAT - {vat}%, min. quantity and step - 1.
import.summary: To add: {create} · to update: {update} · with errors: {error}

rowErrors.category_not_guessed: The category couldn't be worked out from the name
rowErrors.duplicate_sku_in_file: The code appears twice in the file

photos.found: Photos found in the file: {count}. Without a photo: {missing}.
photos.skipped: Photos we couldn't use: {count} (not PNG, JPEG or WebP, or several photos in one row and we use the first).
photos.private: Photos appear only in your own catalog. After adding, you can replace a photo on any product.
photos.uploaded: Photos added: {ok}. Not added: {failed}. Upload the ones that failed from the product page.
photos.noCode: A photo is tied to a product by its code, so rows without a code get no photo. Turn on "Create the code" or point to a code column.

fallbacks.title: What to do if something is missing from the file
fallbacks.hint: This applies only to empty cells. A category or unit that is written in is never changed: if it's wrong, the row shows as an error.
fallbacks.category: Category, if it's not in the file
fallbacks.guessHint: Only guesses the standard categories; anything it can't guess shows as an error. During the check each row's category is visible - take a look.
fallbacks.unit: Unit, if it's not in the file
fallbacks.autoSku: Create the code (SKU) automatically if it's not in the file
fallbacks.autoSkuHint: The code is derived from the product name, so uploading the same file again updates the products and doesn't duplicate them. If you rename a product, a new product is created.

import.hasErrorsNote: The file has errors. Fix them and upload again, or import only the valid rows.
import.doneCheckTitle: Check the products that were added
import.doneCheckBody: In some places we filled in the category, unit and code automatically. Look through the product list: the name, price, category and unit. You can fix a mistake right away by opening the product.

errors.nothing_to_import: There are no rows to import.
errors.suspended: Your account is suspended - importing isn't possible.

settings.deliveryTermsHint: E.g.: delivery Monday to Saturday, the day after the order.
settings.orderCutoffHint: E.g.: orders placed before 15:00 are delivered the next day.

pricing.intro: A list decides which products a customer sees and at what price: only the products ticked in their list are visible. If you don't set a price, the base price applies.

supplierRequest.title: Sell more easily - to your own buyers
supplierRequest.intro: Gusto helps suppliers receive orders from restaurants, cafés and hotels in one place - instead of WhatsApp and phone calls.
supplierRequest.point2: Your customers repeat an order at your prices in a few taps.
supplierRequest.point3: Prices stay private: each customer sees only their own prices.
supplierRequest.point4: Import your catalog from Excel, with a separate price list for each customer.
supplierRequest.formIntro: Fill in the short form. We'll check the company, contact you, and after approval you'll receive a sign-in link by email. Sending the form doesn't create an account yet.

terms.metaDescription: The terms of using Gusto for suppliers and buyers.
terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of Gusto. By using the service you agree to them. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.

sections.title: What Gusto is
paragraphs: Gusto is an online platform where suppliers (distributors, importers, producers) put their catalog and their existing customers, and customers (restaurants, cafés, hotels) send orders to their suppliers.
An order sent on Gusto is a purchase request. The sale takes place only between the buyer and the supplier, the way they usually do it. Gusto is not a party to that transaction.
Gusto does not take payments, does not charge commission, does not carry out deliveries and does not control prices, availability or the quality of goods.

sections.title: The pilot stage
paragraphs: Gusto is currently in a pilot stage and is free. Features may change, be paused or be discontinued.
We offer the service as it is, without a guarantee of uninterrupted operation.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Only a business that Gusto has approved can sign in to Gusto. The service is meant for businesses, not for personal use.
When you create an organization you must give the correct name and legal ID (9 digits for a company, 11 digits for a sole trader). An administrator may check this data.
Until an organization is approved, access may be limited. For example, a buyer won't be able to send an order.

sections.title: Account and security
paragraphs: Your email and password are your organization's access, and protecting them is your responsibility. The password must be at least 10 characters long.
Don't pass your account on to anyone else. If you suspect a stranger is using it, contact us immediately.

sections.title: For suppliers
paragraphs: If you are a supplier on Gusto:
items: You are responsible for the accuracy of your catalog, prices, VAT and availability.
Prices and price lists are seen only by the buyers you invited and whose connection is active.
You upload texts and photos only if you have the right to use them.
You can confirm an order (changing quantities if needed) or reject it, giving a reason when rejecting.

sections.title: For buyers
paragraphs: If you are a buyer on Gusto:
items: An order is a request until the supplier confirms it. The supplier can change quantities or decline the order.
You can cancel an order until the supplier confirms it.
When you send an order we re-check the prices. If anything changed, we show you the new data and ask you to confirm again.
A supplier's prices and terms are confidential. Don't pass them to third parties or publish them without the supplier's consent.

sections.title: Notifications and WhatsApp
paragraphs: Gusto sends you notifications about orders in the app and by email. You can switch off email notifications in the notification settings.
The "Send on WhatsApp" button only opens WhatsApp with a ready text. You send the text yourself. Gusto sends nothing on WhatsApp and does not keep any information about whether a message was sent.

sections.title: Prohibited use
paragraphs: When using the service you may not:
items: try to access someone else's account or another organization's data;
scrape data from the service automatically or overload it;
post false or unlawful information;
get around security or rate limits.

sections.title: Suspension and closing
paragraphs: An administrator may suspend an organization if these terms are breached or there is a security risk. A suspended buyer can't send new orders, and a suspended supplier works in view-only mode.
You can ask to close your account using the contact given below.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, Gusto is not liable for the transaction between a buyer and a supplier, for prices, quality, delivery, payment, or disputes between them. Nor for losses caused by the service being temporarily unavailable.
This does not limit any liability that the law does not allow to be limited.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms. We'll tell you about a significant change in the service or by email. Using the service after an update means you agree to the new terms.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the law of Georgia. We'll first try to settle any dispute by negotiation; otherwise it will be heard by the competent court of Georgia.

privacy.metaDescription: How we process and protect personal data in Gusto.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Here we explain what data we collect, why, who we share it with and what rights you have.

sections.title: Who processes your data
paragraphs: Personal data is processed by the organization named at the end of this page (the controller). In this policy we call it "we".
The policy covers the use of Gusto: the site, sign-in and the ordering service.

sections.title: What data we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what we need for the service to work:
items: Account: email, name, phone and your role in the organization.
Organization: name, legal ID, city, contact person, phone and delivery addresses.
Orders: contents, quantities, prices, statuses, comments and the history of changes.
Catalog (for suppliers): products, prices, price lists and images.
Notifications and your notification settings.

Invitations: when a buyer invites a supplier, we keep the supplier's name and the phone or email given, so the link can be sent and the invitation's status shown. This data is visible only to the buyer who sent the invitation. A supplier who writes to us through the link sees the name of the buyer who invited them.
When you sign in with Google, Google gives us your email and name. We don't receive your Google password.
Technical data: we use the IP address only to protect against abuse (limiting the number of requests) and keep it in encrypted (hashed) form, for a short time.

Error reports: when an error happens in the service, we send the error description, the page address and the type of browser or device to an error monitoring service. We remove emails, cookies, request parameters, identification tokens and entered data from the reports.
Administrators' security-related actions (for example, approving an organization) are kept in a log.

sections.title: What we use it for
items: To create your account and provide the service: orders, catalog, notifications.
To verify organizations and prevent fraud.
For security and to protect against abuse.
To contact you and answer your questions.
To meet our legal obligations.
closing: We don't sell data and don't use it for advertising.

sections.title: Who we share it with
items: The buyer and the supplier you deal with: the organization's name, the contact person and the order data. One supplier can't see another's customers or prices.
Gusto administrators: contact and status information, and order lookup. Every order lookup is recorded in the log. Administrators' support tools don't show price lists or the catalog.

Service providers that process data on our behalf: the database, sign-in and file storage (Supabase), hosting (Vercel), email sending (Resend), error monitoring (Sentry), and Google if you sign in that way.

When you remove the background from a product photo, your browser downloads a helper model file once from Hugging Face, which therefore sees your IP address. The photo itself is processed on your device and sent nowhere.
Public authorities, only in cases required by law.
closing: Some providers may also process data outside Georgia. In that case we take the requirements of the law into account.

sections.title: How long we keep it
items: We keep your account and organization while you use the service. We deactivate organizations and products rather than delete them, so that order history isn't lost.
Orders and their history are kept as a business record for both sides.
We keep encrypted backups for a limited time, about 14 days.
Technical records for protection against abuse are deleted after about a day.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the law of Georgia you have the right to know what data we process, to receive a copy of it, to ask for it to be corrected, blocked or deleted, and to object to its processing.
To make a request, contact us at the address given at the end of this page. We'll reply within the time set by law.
Deletion may be limited if we need the data to meet a legal obligation or to protect another party's rights, for example the order history.
If you believe your rights have been violated, you can apply to the Personal Data Protection Service or to a court.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: We use only essential cookies: they keep your session after you sign in (they can't be read by browser scripts), remember which side of your business you are working as (buyer or supplier), and remember the language you chose.
We don't use advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Data is transmitted over an encrypted connection. Organizations' data is kept apart: every request on the server is checked against your organization's rights. Backups are encrypted.
No system is completely secure. In case of an incident we'll meet the obligations the law sets.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy. We'll publish the updated version on this same page and change the date of the last update. We'll tell you about a significant change in the service or by email.
